title: Thule Society founder initiated in Kurdistan

tellings.quote: >> And the Thu Society, oddly enough, it was founded by this guy, Baron Rudolfph von Spottenorf, >> who was initiated in Kurdistan of all places.

plain: The Thule Society, a German secret society, was founded by a man called Baron Rudolf von Sebottendorf, who had been initiated into secret teachings in Kurdistan, of all places. The researcher Jason Jorjani tells this without naming a source, also bringing up the occult writer Helena Blavatsky. If true, it would trace the group's roots back to the Middle East.
